name: aMail
author: Steve Barrett
description: An email harness that wrangles many accounts into one funnel for your agents, and works as a simple mail client too. Every IMAP/SMTP inbox in one hub, one MCP endpoint, and an analyzed/not-analyzed flag on each message next to read/unread. Bar counters for both queues, a keyboard triage panel, toasts, and a first-run wizard. Client mode follows an aMail server you already run; server mode runs aMail here. New mail is pushed (IMAP IDLE → SSE) so the badge moves within a second.

barWidget.description: Unread and not-yet-analyzed counts across every connected mailbox. Left-click = triage panel · middle-click = refresh · right-click = open aMail.

schema.label: Show the icon when the count is zero
